item_name: S&W M/P Assisted Open Knife/Drop Point
item_short_desc: The Smith and Wesson Military & Police Assisted Open Knife features a 3.60 inch 4034 stainless steel blade with a 5 inch aluminum handle with rubber outlay. It includes a thumb knob finger, actuator, glass breaker, safety lock, and a liner lock.
